text:
mike.sales: Quick handoff — KaliCorp (MidMarket, signed yesterday). Main asks: SSO + private VPC test environment. Sales notes: 3 prod-facing agents, pilot in 2 weeks, renewal cadence 12 months.

anna.cs: Thanks — CS owning onboarding. Current status: contract signed; payment cleared. Preflight checklist done except SSO and VPC networking.

anna.cs: Known risks: SSO (Okta) sometimes returns 500 during SAML callback; they need on-prem connectors verified. Also they plan >10k daily inference tokens after pilot — need Dedicated sizing.

ravi.support: I'll triage SSO. Please send the recent error logs and a reproducible flow.

sara.eng: For VPC connectivity we need their VPN config + expected egress IPs. Also for Dedicated sizing, need workload profile: tokens/req, concurrent sessions.

onboard-bot: KaliCorp onboarding doc: https://redwood-internal/onboarding/kalicorp — includes checklist, runbook, and SSO troubleshoot steps :link:

anna.cs: Quick ask to Sales: @mike.sales can you share the Okta SAML metadata and the network engineer contact? Also confirm pilot start date (Sales said 04/05 in contract but need confirm).

mike.sales: Sending metadata now, network contact is jess.network@kalicorp.com. Pilot tentative 2024-04-05 — Jess will confirm by EOD.

ravi.support: Assigned ticket #CS-1432. Will update with root cause by EOD tomorrow. If SAML 500s are caused by assertion size we may need to patch our SAML parser.

sara.eng: I'll allocate 2 dev-hours to look at SAML parser if Ravi reproduces. For Dedicated, estimate initial pool: 2x A10s for pilot — we'll refine after perf test.

anna.cs: Owners & next steps:
- Sales (mike.sales): confirm pilot date + send Okta metadata (in progress)
- Support (ravi.support): triage SSO, ticket CS-1432
- Eng (sara.eng): standby for parser debug + VPC sizing
- CS (anna.cs): schedule kickoff, runbook handoff, prep onboarding walkthrough

anna.cs: I'll schedule kickoff for 2024-04-02 10:00 PT and invite @ravi.support, @sara.eng, mike.sales, and KaliCorp stakeholders. Any objections?

mike.sales: no objections, go ahead :thumbsup:

ravi.support: good for me.

sara.eng: ok.

anna.cs: Thanks all — I'll post the calendar invite and drop the kickoff agenda in the onboarding doc, and will ping again when we have the Okta metadata.
